name: exact-web-mirror
description: Capture a live web page and produce an exact, fully-offline local copy — the site's own real HTML/CSS/JS/fonts/video running in a normal browser, not a hand-rebuilt approximation. Record-and-replay archiving that survives modern JavaScript-app sites where 'Save Page As' and wget fall apart, and that verifies its own fidelity against the live page with screenshots.
